collection-neighbor-02.title: Safe help beside a stalled car
collection-neighbor-02.alt: A man makes a phone call beside a woman and a parked SUV in a broad gravel pullout, with a road visible far downhill.
collection-neighbor-02.caption: The two people wait together in a broad pullout while a call is made. The Samaritan's care invites practical attention to what is needed, without requiring us to provide every kind of help ourselves.
